system_interpretation.plain_language_change: Kraft Heinz updated its risk factors to explicitly state that creditors holding its debt could accelerate repayment upon default, potentially triggering cross-defaults on other debt. The company acknowledges that if operating performance declines or it fails to comply with covenants (such as timely SEC filings), it may need to seek waivers from creditors. The update clarifies that if waivers are denied or compliance cannot be remedied, the company would be in default and unable to access its Senior Credit Facility. This replaces prior language focused on LIBOR transition and general market liquidity risks with specific language about covenant breaches and credit facility access.
